title: A sprint's start gate is not made terminal-only by a member's directory or glob touch above _tools/tests_ceiling.json
goal: a sprint whose member touches _tools/, . or _tools/*.json does not get a ceiling-class start gate that only the operator's own terminal can answer, either because the start gate is left out of the terminal-only rule or because ceiling is derived only from an exact touch of the file or a glob that matches it alone; the choice is a gate for the operator, and backlog.md documents it
